name: Halden Ceramics (Demo)
description:
DEMO PROJECT. Halden Ceramics is a fictional small-batch pottery studio invented to show how the Library works. Nothing here is a real client, a real website, or a real Claude review.

The imagined brief: a calm, tactile portfolio and shop with an asymmetric editorial layout, slow glaze-reveal motion on the hero, and a seasonal kiln-firing calendar.
